proposal: A strategy is a deterministic, documented rule set (selection logic + sizing rule) submitted as data. Vague or discretionary submissions are rejected at registration.
source_label: NFL Big Data Bowl (official competition precedent)

proposal: Three divisions: (1) Single bets, (2) Parlays (multi-game and same-game), (3) Player-prop combos. Leaderboards are scored per division; a strategy may enter several divisions.

Closing-line-value-adjusted ROI in units: profit/loss graded from official results, every selection benchmarked to the closing line; CLV-adjusted score is the primary ranking metric so that luck is separated from skill.
status: PROPOSED — DECISION REQUIRED (requires odds source, Q2)

proposal: Calibration (Brier score) for probability claims, and maximum drawdown as the tie-breaker.
Tiered rewards for top-ranked strategies at season end (Tier 1 / Tier 2 / Tier 3). Reward type and size are owner decisions; no reward value is published here.
source_label: NFL Big Data Bowl ($100,000 shared prize — official precedent)

proposal: A strategy earns reward eligibility only after passing every validation gate (V1–V8). Gates unrun or failed = ineligible, regardless of raw profit.
Weekly leaderboard updates during NFL weeks (graded from official results); season champion graded after the Super Bowl LXI anchor (Feb 14, 2027, officially listed).

The competition does not model categories the NFL's official integrity policy flags: player-injury markets, officiating-related markets, one-play-determinable outcomes, pre-determined outcomes; prediction-market-style contracts are excluded.
source_label: NFL integrity & betting policy (prohibited wager categories)

proposal: Every leaderboard row links to the official result sources used for grading and to the strategy's rule document; unverified values stay blank.

The league's own rewarded analytics competition is the official precedent: 9th annual Big Data Bowl, NGS tracking data, shared $100,000 prize, Kaggle-hosted, winners' concepts adopted into official Next Gen Stats metrics.
